text:
DeployBot: rollout v4.4.0 -> prod started. Canary 5%. Observability: embeddings p95 +55% on canary nodes. Autorevert: OFF (manual review). Please ack and recommend rollback scope.
Ivy: ack. spike isolated to embeddings route, no error surge but latency tail up.
Ravi: logs show increased KV eviction and retry attempts. text-gen unaffected.
SRE_Anita: propose route-level pin to last stable v4.3.7 for embeddings to limit blast radius.
OpsKai: who runs the pin? change window policy requires Ops + SRE signoff. I have perms to run command.
PM_Lucas: freeze release notes until we confirm. If we pin, prepare a short customer advisory for enterprise seats.
Ivy: suggested command:
```
redwoodctl route set --route embeddings --version v4.3.7 --reason "canary p95 regression" --expires 45m
```
Ravi: open a revert PR for the runtime change (repo@commit b7c2f1) as safety.
SRE_Anita: approving route pin. OpsKai please execute, I will confirm.
OpsKai: executing now. /run redwoodctl route set --route embeddings --version v4.3.7 --reason "manual-pin-canary-latency"
DeployBot: action accepted: embeddings route pinned to v4.3.7 by OpsKai at 3510000032. Canary traffic for new runtime reduced to 0% for embeddings.
Ivy: monitoring — p95 back to baseline in 3m. no error rise. :thumbsup:
PM_Lucas: adding release metadata: "embeddings routed to v4.3.7 due to canary latency regression; investigating". Freezing other release notes.
Ravi: created revert PR #501 and linked incident.
SRE_Anita: alerts on watch for 30m; extend if needed. If regression persists elsewhere, we escalate to full revert.
OpsKai: override expires at 3510000302 unless extended.
PM_Lucas: Customer advisory draft ready; Ivy will send after review.
Ivy: sent to enterprise list.
DeployBot: archived under incident/INC-2026-050.
Ravi: filing postmortem stub.
OpsKai: closing thread and moving to postmortems channel. Thanks everyone.
